description:
Reincarnated into a ridiculously melodramatic novel filled with betrayal, deception, and absurd plot twists, a young woman finds herself in the role of a girl destined to become a notorious villainess. 

Although the duke raises her despite her questionable origins, she is fated to betray him and ultimately cause his death. Worse still, the truth behind her actions will only be revealed after she has already been executed by the vengeful duchess. Knowing that her fate is sealed by her villainous mother's curse, she decides to play the part of a minor villain and escape this twisted world before it's too late. 

But in a story where nothing ever goes according to plan, will she really be able to change her fate and survive?
